features.title: Search projects and browse folder paths
features.summary: Match registered project labels and canonical directories, browse absolute or home-relative paths through the Host, mark confirmed secondary JJ workspaces when classification is available, and preserve project identity in returned choices.
failureModes: Home-relative paths resolve against the Host-reported home before listing.
Canonical path is returned separately from display name.
Unavailable JJ classification leaves rows unmarked.

verification.testName: searches registered project names and canonical paths
keeps project identity and canonical folder path explicit
resolves home-relative queries using the Host-reported home path

features.title: Select project folders with keyboard navigation
features.summary: Move through result rows with wrapped selection and handle empty lists without selecting an invalid row.
failureModes: Keyboard actions on an empty list do not invent a selection.

verification.testName: wraps keyboard selection and handles an empty list

features.title: Offer recent folders not yet registered as projects
features.summary: After registered project matches, offer eligible recent folders and keep their canonical path distinct from registered project identity.
failureModes: Recent directory selection cannot claim an existing project ID until Host registration succeeds.

verification.testName: offers unregistered recent folders after matching projects

features.title: Start directly in the Host folder browser
features.summary: Consumers can open the picker with directory browsing active while omitting registered-project choices and registration actions.
failureModes: The default project mode remains unchanged for existing consumers.
Directory-only mode begins at the Host home listing.

verification.testName: preserves project mode by default and starts directory mode at Host home
